name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 43 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-11-06, at wavelengths from 1.09 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
